verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test workspace is a fair question for a SaaS code-review platform, but the evidence never documents an isolated environment for testing cubic away from production repositories or data. The closest item is auto-approval "shadow mode" (cubic-docs-12), which is a dry-run preview of one feature, not sandbox isolation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
